name: Monitor Kernel Plant
implementation_notes: kernel_plant_record/kernel_plant_detail local SQLite tables in localSchema.ts unchanged by this revision (same columns/unique constraint, including downtime_minutes integer + findings free-text kept as two distinct columns) -- only the row-population pattern changed, and the Kernel Plant-specific comment blocks were updated to describe the dynamic design (Threshing's/Depricarping's own comment blocks in the same file were left as stale 'FIXED 24-row' documentation by their sibling fixes -- not this agent's files to touch)

kernelPlantRecordRepo.ts covers all 3 mobile Kernel Plant screens (040/044/048) in one file, same convention as depricarpingRecordRepo.ts covering screens 039/043/047; its full unit test coverage (kernelPlantRecordRepo.spec.ts, 29 tests) is reported under this screen since it was authored first in sequence

REVISED 2026-08-24 (entity-catalog v12, correcting the original design the user explicitly rejected): createDraft() now inserts ONLY the header row -- the 24 pre-created kernel_plant_detail rows were a literal reading of the paper log-sheet mockup that wasted screen space; rows are now added one at a time by the user in Form Kernel Plant via 'Tambah baris', exactly mirroring depricarpingRecordRepo.ts's/pressingRecordRepo.ts's/threshingRecordRepo.ts's fixed pattern (itself mirroring cagesTrackRecordRepo.ts's cages_tipped_time pattern) -- Kernel Plant is the LAST of the 4 stations to receive this fix

'Jumlah Baris Time-Slot Terisi' counter redefined as a plain COUNT(*) of kernel_plant_detail rows belonging to today's records -- no longer filtered by 'has >=1 of 9 reading columns filled', since row existence itself is now the meaningful signal (a row only exists because the user explicitly added it); MonitorKernelPlantView.vue's counter field renamed from filledSlotCount/counter-filled-slot-count to detailRowCount/counter-detail-row-count, mirroring MonitorDepricarpingView.vue's already-renamed shape

kernelPlantOperationalTargets.ts uses a 3-column shape (equipment_parameter/target_benchmark/corrective_action_plan) matching Threshing's/Pressing's shape, NOT Depricarping's 4-column shape -- UNTOUCHED by this revision

Router: route name 'monitor-kernel-plant' registered in router/index.ts, but StationListView.vue (screen-006, out of this 6-screen task's scope) has NOT been updated to link to it -- see known_issues, same known issue already documented for Threshing/Pressing/Depricarping

Kernel Plant is genuinely unique among the 4 new stations: it combines Depricarping's split downtime_minutes(integer)+findings(text) reading-column shape with Threshing's/Pressing's 3-column Operational Target reference table shape -- this combination required cross-referencing both sibling fixes rather than mirroring a single one wholesale; the 3-column target table itself was left completely untouched by this row-mechanics revision, per the task's explicit instruction.
